en: Monochrome postcard showing a close-up photograph of a medieval stone relief. The relief depicts four seated or crouching human figures carved in high relief within rectangular niches. The central figures handle rectangular objects resembling books or tablets, while the one on the left seems to hold an instrument or wheel. Architectural details like capitals with stylized foliage appear above the figures. At the lower-left corner of the postcard margin, faint printed text reads "Biblioteca de Galicia."
